EX-99.1 2 tm2629728d1_ex99-1.htm EXHIBIT 99.1 Exhibit 99.1 Annovis Provides Corporate Updates and Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results · Last patient, last visit of the 6-month treatment period in the Phase 3 DUET-AD study is scheduled for December 31, 2026, with database lock on February 8, 2027, and data readout in March 2027 · Parkinson’s disease open-label extension (OLE-PD) study has enrolled 326 patients, with enrollment scheduled to close on January 29, 2027 · Annovis raised $21.0 million in gross proceeds through an underwritten public offering, which is expected to fund operations through the 6-month data readout from DUET-AD Malvern, PA, November 13, 2026 -- Annovis Bio, Inc.

“The third quarter marked a shift in our focus from enrolling patients in DUET-AD to executing the trial and preparing for the first data readout and for filing a New Drug Application (NDA),” said Maria Maccecchini, PhD, President and CEO of Annovis.
“We now have dates set for last patient, last visit of the 6-month treatment period and for database lock, as well as financing in place to carry us through topline results in March 2027.

The team is working very hard to deliver clean data and an on-time readout.” Clinical highlights Alzheimer’s disease – DUET-AD · Study description: The pivotal Phase 3 trial has been given the acronym DUET-AD (Dual Efficacy Trial in Alzheimer’s Disease), reflecting its unique design with two prespecified data readouts – at 6 months (symptomatic) and at 18 months (disease-modifying). · Enrollment : DUET-AD is fully enrolled, with 862 patients who have early AD (MMSE 20-28) and are positive for the plasma biomarker pTau217.
The Company aims to prepare a significant part of the NDA before the 6-month data readout from DUET-AD.

Upcoming milestones · DUET-AD: Annovis expects last patient, last visit of the 6-month treatment period on December 31, 2026, and database lock on February 8, 2027, with topline results in March 2027.
